mapper.insert: INSERT INTO playlists (id, user_id, name, mood_tag, is_public) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{moodTag}, #{isPublic})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.name, p.mood_tag, p.is_public, COUNT(ps.id) AS song_count, p.created_at FROM playlists p LEFT JOIN playlist_songs ps ON ps.playlist_id = p.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY p.id, p.user_id, p.name, p.mood_tag, p.is_public, p.created_at ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO playlist_songs (id, playlist_id, song_id, order_num) VALUES (#{id}, #{playlistId}, #{songId}, #{orderNum})
